excluded_attempts: SDK tool-activation preflight errors: not engine failures.
32K/10-minute pilot: no local editing, unequal browser delays.
64K Halogen v2: animated test browser CPU contention; no matched Kyojin request.
Bare Kyojin seed 4104: first collection interrupted by the parent command limit; one same-seed technical recapture, not a quality retry.
Preliminary 1280x633 screenshots excluded; comparison frames are 1280x900.

method.prompt: Design and create a very creative, elaborate, and detailed voxel art scene of a pagoda in a beautiful garden with trees, including some cherry blossoms. Make the scene impressive and varied and use colorful voxels. Use whatever libraries to get this done but make sure I can paste it all into a single HTML file.
method.bare: One original greedy repeat and five stochastic no-tools samples per engine; temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, top_k 20, min_p 0, seeds 4101-4105, thinking off, max_tokens 16384.
method.agent: One real Pi SDK trial per engine, read/write/unique-edit/inspect tools, seed 5101, same stochastic sampling, 65536 output tokens total, 16384 per request, 1200 seconds, 12 assistant responses, 3 inspections.
method.browser: 1280x900, observe after a 10-second window, save screenshot and current-route errors. No human repair hints. Close each owned browser before inference; sample CPU before every model request.
method.limits: Different packs/templates remain. No aesthetic score or population success-rate estimate. Interactions not exhaustively tested. Blank/loading/error/timeout outcomes are distinct.
method.privacy: Text records have host paths and operator identifiers scrubbed; request workspace paths become <workspace>. PNG bytes are unchanged. Manifest hashes describe these published bytes, not unsanitized private records.
